name: QuestionPro
description_en:
QuestionPro is a hosted survey and research platform with separate offerings for market research, customer experience and employee experience. Its survey workflow covers building questions, applying logic, distributing the study and analyzing or exporting responses. More specialized research, audience recruitment and experience programmes sit alongside the survey editor, rather than being guaranteed inclusions of every account.

The free Essentials tier can serve a bounded questionnaire, while paid editions add capacity and advanced functionality. Selection should begin with required question types, branching paths, audience access and exports. The current homepage highlights AI survey generation and analysis, but generated questions or synthetic data are not equivalent to collecting answers from real participants.
description_zh:
QuestionPro 是托管问卷与研究平台，另有市场研究、客户体验和员工体验产品。问卷流程包括创建问题、配置逻辑、分发研究，以及分析或导出回答。专业研究、受众招募和体验管理项目与编辑器并列，不能假设所有账户都包含。

免费 Essentials 可承载有明确规模边界的问卷，付费版本扩充容量及高级能力。选型应先确认题型、分支路径、受众来源和导出要求。现行首页重点介绍 AI 生成问卷与分析，但生成的问题或合成数据，不等于向真实参与者收集了回答。

pricing.billing_basis: Survey edition and per-user subscription with annual response allowances; team minimums and custom Research Suite pricing.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Essentials is free for one user, with up to ten surveys and 200 responses per survey. Advanced lists $99/user/month billed annually, one user and 25,000 responses/year. Team Edition lists $83/user/month billed annually, five or more users and 100,000 responses/year. Advanced offers a ten-day trial. Research Suite is quoted and lists ten or more users with custom response pricing; CX and EX have separate pricing requests.

sections.title_en: Choose the study design before a creation shortcut
sections.title_zh: 先选研究设计，再选创建捷径
sections.en:
QuestionPro documents blank surveys, templates and Word-document import. Word import is available when creating a new survey, before questions have been added manually. The service then separates branding, distribution and analysis. AI-generated surveys can be a starting point, but the researcher still needs to check wording, response options and the purpose of each question.

For an illustrative product study, write down the decision the answers should inform, create the screening and follow-up questions, and test with a small sample. This avoids confusing a quickly generated questionnaire with a valid study.
sections.zh:
QuestionPro 记录了空白问卷、模板和 Word 导入三种方式。Word 导入限新建问卷且尚未手动添加问题时使用，随后再进行品牌设置、分发及分析。AI 问卷可以作为起点，但措辞、选项与每题目的仍需由研究者检查。

例如产品研究，应先写清回答要支持什么决策，再建立筛选题与追问，用小样本预检。不能把快速生成的问卷直接视为有效研究。

sections.title_en: Completion and termination have different meanings
sections.title_zh: 完成与终止的记录含义不同
sections.en:
The branching guide recommends building the entire questionnaire before adding logic. Branching can jump to a later question, chain another survey, show a thank-you page or terminate the response. Applying it inserts a page break required for the logic to work; that break cannot be removed.

A thank-you destination marks the response complete, whereas termination marks it terminated. For a screening question about product eligibility, test both paths and inspect their statuses. Otherwise, an ineligible respondent could be counted as a completed interview simply because the wrong end destination was selected.
sections.zh:
分支文档建议先建完整问卷再加逻辑。分支可跳至后续题目、串接另一问卷、显示感谢页或终止回答，添加时会插入逻辑所需分页，不能删除。

感谢页将回答标为完成，终止则标为终止。例如用产品资格题筛选时，应测试两种路径及其记录状态，否则仅因选错结束目标，不合格人员也可能被计成完成访谈。

sections.title_en: Treat editions and product families as separate decisions
sections.title_zh: 区分版本选择与产品家族
sections.en:
The comparison covers question types, logic, distribution, exports and specialist analyses. Its extracted text loses many checkmarks, so a feature name is not reliable evidence that Essentials includes it. The pricing page distinguishes Advanced, Team and Research Suite; the website separately presents CX and EX programmes.

Conjoint, MaxDiff, audience services, advanced security and offline-app needs should be checked against the intended license. No account was opened to verify a feature entitlement. Synthetic datasets highlighted on the homepage must not be reported as observed human responses.
sections.zh:
比较页包含题型、逻辑、分发、导出和专业分析，但纯文本抽取丢失许多勾选，出现功能名不能证明 Essentials 包含该项。定价页区分 Advanced、Team 和 Research Suite，网站另列 CX、EX 项目。

联合分析、MaxDiff、受众服务、高级安全和离线应用，应按所选许可逐项确认。本文未开户核对权益。首页强调的合成数据不能报告为真实人类回答。

sections.title_en: Read user minimums together with response periods
sections.title_zh: 同时核对人数下限与回答周期
sections.en:
Essentials has one user, up to ten surveys and 200 responses per survey. Advanced advertises $99 per user per month billed annually with 25,000 yearly responses. Team advertises $83 per user per month billed annually but requires at least five users and lists 100,000 yearly responses. The lower Team unit price is not a one-user purchase offer.

At the displayed minimum, five Team users imply $415 per month equivalent and $4,980 per year before tax or negotiated terms. This is an illustrative calculation, not a checkout quote. Research Suite uses custom response pricing and ten-plus users; recruited audiences and separate experience products need their own commercial confirmation.
sections.zh:
Essentials 为 1 人、最多 10 份问卷，每份 200 条回答。Advanced 年付折合每人每月 $99，含每年 25,000 条回答。Team 年付折合每人每月 $83，但至少 5 人，每年 100,000 条回答。较低的 Team 单价不是单人购买报价。

按展示下限计算，5 人 Team 折合每月 $415、每年 $4,980，未含税费或另行约定条件。这只是算例，不是结账报价。Research Suite 为定制回答费率且至少 10 人，招募受众和其他体验产品应单独核价。

sections.title_en: Confirm the downstream evidence you need
sections.title_zh: 确认最终需要什么研究证据
sections.en:
QuestionPro is worth investigating when structured logic, analysis and a range of survey methods matter. For a minimal poll, the edition limits and complexity may outweigh the extra tools. Before rollout, verify a response export containing a skipped question, a terminated response and a non-English answer; compare it with the analysis you intend to perform.

This recommendation is not an executed test. No self-hosting package or source license was established. Data-center choices differ across editions, and exact residency, retention, failure recovery, SMS costs and interface-language availability were not verified.
sections.zh:
需要结构化逻辑、分析和多种问卷方法时，QuestionPro 值得进一步核查。若只是简易投票，版本限制和操作复杂度可能比额外工具更值得关注。推广前建议导出包含跳题、终止回答及非英语回答的数据，核对能否支持预期分析。

这不是已执行的测试。本次未确认自托管服务包或源码许可。数据中心选择随版本不同，准确存储地区、保留、失败恢复、短信费用和界面语言仍未核实。

research_gaps: No live survey, distribution, branching, offline app, AI output or export was executed.
Feature-table checkmarks were not preserved in extracted text; exact advanced-feature entitlements require account or vendor confirmation.
Additional response charges, SMS and audience costs, contractual residency/retention, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.
